atoms.text: Even as a little boy, Alonso had many dreams and ideas of how to improve the life for the people living in his city Oscudirad. The biggest obstacle to a better life was the lack of sunlight in winter. However, no one could devise a plan to fix this problem. One day, Alonso declared that he would dedicate his life to finding a way to brighten up the long, dark days. Prior to Alonso, many other people from Oscuridad had tried to invent something that would brighten up the city, but they had not been successful. Most people had accepted their fate. Alonso, however, was determined to find a way to make the impossible possible.
